name: Kibiki Kou
source:
Likes: Sacred places, ruins, green tea
Dislikes: Skeptics, crowded locations
Hobbies: Collecting small antiques

A paranormal and horror novelist and a victim trapped in Heavenly Host. He is the guardian and mentor of [url=/c6509]Naho[/url], a student who adores him. He went in to Heavenly Host after performing [url=/c6510]Sachiko[/url] Ever After with [url=/c11261]Taguchi[/url], the cameraman.

[From the [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Kou_Kibiki]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
